elaine_cs: Heads-up — enterprise customer (ACME) reporting 403s on both /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings immediately after their SSO key rotation. They say tokens look fine on their side but our auth logs only show a subset of scopes.

elaine_cs: snippet from their client error: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": 403,
    "message": "insufficient_scope",
    "details": "missing: embeddings,rerank"
  }
}
```

sriram_engineer: Can you paste the exact curl they used (headers + token) and the tenant id? I want to repro locally. My hunch: delimiter normalization or header truncation in an ingress.

elaine_cs: curl they ran (sanitized):
```bash
curl -i 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci..." 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"input": "summarize this"}' 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
```
Response they get (exact):
```json
{
  "status": 403,
  "error": "insufficient_scope",
  "missing": ["embeddings"]
}
```

jordan_prodops: We saw a similar ticket last week where the ingress truncated a long SAML attribute header. In that case the scope list was space-separated and the proxy turned it into a single token (only the first scope). Which ingress is ACME using?

elaine_cs: They said they go through our SaaS connector (webhook + proxy) + their IdP. Tenant: acme-prod-42. Our auth logs for that tenant show:

```text
[auth] tenant=acme-prod-42 token_id=svc-123 claims.scope="inference"
```
(so only 'inference' arrived)

marta_security: Two things to validate: 1) the SAML -> OIDC provisioning mapping (are we reading attribute 'entitlements' vs 'scope'?), 2) delimiter handling (comma vs space). Some IdPs emit space-delimited scopes, some CSV. If our provisioner stores "inference,embeddings,rerank" but the verifier splits only on spaces, that can look like a single combined scope or get truncated.

sriram_engineer: I reproduced quickly on staging with a long scope set. Our authz service used String.split(" ") when reading stored scope claim. If the stored claim is "inference,embeddings,rerank" split(" ") yields a single token. Patch applied to split on /[,\s]+/ and normalize to space-delimited canonical list.

deploy-bot: deploy 3367895 by sriram_engineer -> staging succeeded (2026-03-17T10:12:30Z). :rocket:

jordan_prodops: Also increased max header length on the ingress for the SaaS connector (was 8KB, bumped to 16KB) — pushed as a config rollback risk mitigation.

elaine_cs: I asked ACME to retry with their rotated key. They did a test call against our staging tenant and reported success: no 403s, embeddings and rerank both work now.

marta_security: I'll open a ticket to audit the provisioning pipeline for other tenants with CSV scopes. Long-term we should canonicalize scope storage to an array (backfill script).

elaine_cs: Customer confirmed in prod after we rolled the patch + ingress bump to prod; they saw no 403s over the next 45m. ACME happy, escalations closed. :white_check_mark:

elaine_cs: Notes for postmortem: root cause = delimiter/normalization mismatch between IdP -> provisioner -> verifier + header-length edge case on SaaS connector. Action items: canonicalize scope storage, add unit test for comma vs space, add monitoring alert for tenants with mismatched claims.
